column1: # Findings of the ZAP baseline scan (.github/workflows/dynamic-security.yml) that we have looked at and accept.
# One per line, three columns separated by a TAB: <rule id> <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> <reason in parentheses>.
# Every line needs a reason that says WHY it is not a problem here. A finding that is a real problem is fixed, not listed.
# The rule ids are in the scan report (the artifact "zap-baseline-report").
# First run, 14 Oct 2026: 0 failures, 9 warnings. The 9 are below.

column3: (Re-examine Cache-control: the pages it names are the app shell. They carry no personal data in the HTML; the data arrives through signed-in API calls. Revisit the API cache headers in the QA, issue 99)
(X-Content-Type-Options missing: only on /cdn-cgi/ files that Cloudflare serves itself, not on our pages)
(Strict-Transport-Security not set: only on /cdn-cgi/ files that Cloudflare serves itself; our own pages get the header from Caddy)

(KNOWN GAP, not "no problem": there is no Content-Security-Policy yet. A strict one needs nonces for the inline scripts of Next.js and a test of the whole app, so it is a decision for the team lead after the QA. Remove this line when a CSP is added)
(Non-storable content: informational, the pages are deliberately not stored by caches)
(Retrieved from cache: informational, Cloudflare serves the static scripts from its cache on purpose)
(Permissions-Policy not set: only on /cdn-cgi/ files that Cloudflare serves itself; our own pages get the header from Caddy)
(Modern Web Application: informational, it only says the site is a single-page application)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp would block cross-origin images and embeds, and nothing here needs SharedArrayBuffer)
